subject: Post-demo follow-up + model evals / reported regression
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Priya Srinivasan <priya.s@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + recommended evals / prompt set

Hi Alex / Priya —

Great talking earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

- What we heard: Acme needs consistent summarization quality across multi-paragraph product descriptions and a low tolerance for hallucination in spec extraction.
- Recommended models: start with redwood-v1.5 (quantized) for cost-sensitive routes, and pin redwood-v2.0 for the high-precision extractors.
- Eval plan: run the attached prompt set (acme_prompt_set_v2.csv) across both models + a canary against the latest hosted release.
- Success criteria: F1 >= 0.92 on key-spec extraction, Rouge-L delta < 0.03 vs. baseline.

Attachments: acme_prompt_set_v2.csv, eval_benchmarks_acme_20260325.pdf (baseline results)
Links: Drive evals folder: https://drive.google.com/open?id=acme-evals-20260325

Proposed next steps:
1) You run the prompt set against your staging data and share the top 20 failure cases (we can triage).
2) I’ll schedule a quick follow-up with Vivek and Rachel to walk the eval diffs and pin/rollback options.

Can you confirm a target for the initial run by end of week? Happy to help with formatting or running this on our side if you prefer.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Srinivasan <priya.s@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + recommended evals / prompt set

Thanks Marissa — good notes and the prompt set looks useful. We ran a quick pass overnight and pulled out some concerning patterns. Two quick things:

1) We see a visible drop in extraction precision after your hosted model auto-updated to v2.1 this morning (we were on v2.0 previously). Example attached (acme_example_failure.json) shows missing spec fields and a couple of hallucinated attributes.
2) The aggregated metrics in our staging run show F1 down ~0.08 vs. the baseline you provided. That’s risky for our workflow.

Can you escalate? We need either a pinned route to v2.0 for our account or an immediate rollback of the v2.1 change for the extractor route while you triage.

– Alex
Head of Product | Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com

On the attached: acme_example_failure.json (small sample of 5 items)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Priya Srinivasan <priya.s@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Acme staging run - reported regression after v2.1 update — need triage / rollback options

Team — forwarding Acme’s note. They ran the prompt set against staging and reported a regression correlated with the hosted release to v2.1 this morning. Notes:

- Customer: Acme Corp (deal ACME-2026-001)
- Impact: extraction F1 down ~0.08 vs baseline; small sample attached shows missing fields + hallucinations.
- Ask: pin their routes to v2.0 or rollback the v2.1 release for their tenant while we investigate.

Can we confirm the following ASAP: 
1) Is there a known model diff between v2.0 -> v2.1 that could cause extraction regressions? (Vivek)
2) If so, can we produce a minimal regression diff (top 10 fails) and an ETA to either mitigate or rollback? (Dev / Infra)
3) In the short term, what are the steps to pin a customer route to v2.0? I want to give Acme clear remediation & ETA. (Rachel / Dev)

Alex — looping internal folks to triage. I’ll coordinate a brief (20m) call if helpful.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Priya Srinivasan <priya.s@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme staging run - reported regression after v2.1 update — need triage / rollback options

Thanks for the ping. Quick technical notes after an initial look: 

- Root cause hypothesis: v2.1 introduced a recalibrated decoder temperature schedule + a new tokenization patch for multi-sentence separators that affects boundary detection for our spec extractor prompts. That can plausibly lower precision for extraction-style prompts while improving free-form summarization.
- Immediate actions I can take today:
  * Run a focused diff on the attached sample vs. v2.0 and produce a top-10 failure list and delta report (I’ll upload to the Drive link).
  * Recommend pinning their traffic to redwood-v2.0 for the extractor route. Pinning is a configuration change we can apply at the route level; Rachel/Dev can confirm exact steps.
- Rollback vs pinning: rollback of the global v2.1 release is higher blast radius; pinning per-customer is safer and faster.

Dev / Rachel — can one of you confirm you can implement a route pin to redwood-v2.0 for Acme and the expected ETA (hours)? If so, I’ll prepare the diff report and mitigation plan.

Alex / Priya — sorry for the disruption. We’ll prioritize this and share the top failure cases + a remediation path in the next few hours. If you prefer we run the prompt set on our infra instead of staging to avoid env differences, we can do that — let us know.

Vivek
Staff Applied ML | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
